section.title: Order at boot
section.para: The initramfs MUST prepare the system in this order:

listitem.para: Mount the root filesystem (a disk partition, or a read-only image on live media).

If /overlayer/.syshub-pending holds an upgrade, apply it to /overlayer/syshub on disk. If a rollback was requested, undo the last applied upgrade instead. Nothing may use the base before this step is complete.
Mount zaisys (read-only), zexlib, agents and the other entries of /overlayer at their own paths, and /home and /root from the disk.
Switch to the new root and start the init system.

section.title: Precedence
section.para: Because the userland is the upper layer, a file it holds at the same path as a base file would hide the base file. The package manager therefore MUST NOT install a file at a path the base already provides (). Configuration that an administrator edits in /overlayer/syshub/etc is written to the upper layer by OverlayFS and survives base upgrades.

section.title: Rescue
section.para: An implementation SHOULD provide a kernel command line option that boots the base without the userland layer. Because the base stands on its own, this always yields a working system.

note.title: Implementation note
note.para: Zainium OS uses zainium.overlay=off, and rd.break=pre-mount|pre-overlay|pre-pivot to stop in a shell at a given step.

row.entry: staged, applied at the next boot
